provenance.source_scope: Pinned source provenance, not proof of production execution.
provenance.execution_scope: Sanitized owner-recorded rollout, measurement, recovery, backup, and finalization receipts. Private execution artifacts and production access are not published.
provenance.synthetic_evidence_scope: The existing public eight-scenario ingestion reproduction is separate from this real-deployment observation.

first_attempt_recovery.correction: Moved live SQL observation and backup into the same Linux VM as the writers; the host opens only completed backup copies.
first_attempt_recovery.causal_limit: Synthetic cross-runtime reproduction supports the transport correction; it does not prove the exact original failure cause or SQLite subcode.

measurement.scope: Bounded smoke observation from one deployment, not a capacity benchmark.
measurement.propagation_limit: The interval begins at DB-change detection, not source change or DB commit. Polling leaves the earlier change time unobserved.

limitations: Owner-recorded single-deployment observation, not independent attestation or publicly reproducible production access.
Does not establish capacity, throughput, p95, SLA, uptime, before/after improvement, or source-change/commit-to-API latency.
SQLite code search reads the database on each request; horizontal write scaling remains limited.
Upsert-only ingestion retains rows omitted by later source responses; createdAt records first insertion, not source freshness.
Collection has no immediate retry or backoff; failures are checked on the next scheduled run.
The exact original OperationalError subcode and cause remain unproven.
publication_boundary: Excludes business row counts and contents, credentials, live service addresses, hostnames, host paths, private logs, image/container identifiers, and backup checksums. No execution date is asserted.
